dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body point toward the posterior peduncle, resulting in a pointed geometric terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: The lateral margins are predominantly smooth, though a subtle asymmetrical indentation is visible along the left margin near the mid-section compared to the more linear right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; the dorsal area exhibits high median pixel intensity with a consistent light-grey to white baseline.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse greyish pixel clusters are concentrated in the cranial region surrounding the blowhole and along the midline of the peduncle.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; there is a soft, gradual gradient between the high-reflectance dorsal surface and the lower-intensity shaded lateral margins.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A single, distinct linear longitudinal indentation is present along the central dorsal axis, casting a shadow that defines the dorsal ridge.
